headline: Nigeria Approves N70,000 Monthly Transport Allowance for Public Servants
summary: The Nigerian federal government approved a N70,000 monthly transport allowance for public servants for six months to cushion rising living costs.
why: Public sector wage and allowance adjustments impact fiscal expenditure deficits and domestic consumer demand patterns.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Broad public sector allowances increase government recurrent expenditure while supporting domestic purchasing power.
